Feeding is an important part of conifer care. The main nutrients conifers need are nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P) and potassium (K), plus some trace elements, which are supplied by the microorganisms in GREENODIN BROWN. Feeding conifers in spring is especially important, as this is a period of active growth for many species. A base dose of GREENODIN BROWN improves soil structure, breaks down organic matter and delivers nutrients to the plants. Spread the organic fertilizer around the root zone and work it gently into the soil. Along with feeding, make sure conifers are watered regularly, especially during active growth in spring.

Feeding your lawn with GREENODIN products. With so many fertilizers on the market, it can be hard to tell which one suits your lawn best. The good news is that choosing an organic fertilizer is a simple and effective way to improve the health and look of your lawn while protecting the environment. Mineral fertilizers, also known as chemical fertilizers, deliver a quick boost of nutrients to the soil. However, they can upset the fragile balance of the soil ecosystem, which in the long run leads to soil degradation and poorer plant health. Mineral fertilizers also reduce the nutrient content of the lawn and can release harmful chemicals into the environment. Pets and other animals get a dose of harmful substances from such grass, and bees and insects even more so. Organic fertilizers, on the other hand, improve the overall condition of the soil and the lawn. They are made from natural materials. By using organic fertilizers, you not only give your lawn the nutrients it needs to grow, but also improve the structure and fertility of the soil for the future.
